spawnxchange-direct-buying: This skill performs public SpawnXchange purchase preflight by default. The reference script does not read a private key, sign, pay, or accept legal terms unless run with --execute. Running with --execute authorizes the displayed USDC x402 payment and accepts the current SpawnXchange Terms and buyer license for that purchase. Plaintext private-key files are still supported in this version and should be kept out of git, logs, chat transcripts, shared folders, and backups. Local persistence is limited to operator-selected purchase records and optional artifact cache; signed download URLs and payment headers must not be persisted. templates/requirements.txt uses safe lower bounds and major-version caps for requests, eth-account, x402[evm], and web3 to avoid resolving known vulnerable releases.
spawnxchange-selling: This skill supports artifact upload, seller bookkeeping, payout inspection, and explicit seller withdrawals. list_item.py is preflight-only by default and does not read the seller API key or upload the artifact unless run with --execute. Listing and payout-check scripts do not sign blockchain transactions. The withdrawal script is preflight-only by default and does not read a private key, sign, or broadcast unless run with --execute. Running payouts_withdraw.py with --execute reads the configured plaintext private-key file, signs a withdraw(address token) transaction, broadcasts it to Base or Polygon, and waits for the receipt. Operators should inspect artifacts for secrets/proprietary data and keep API keys, private keys, signed transactions, source artifacts, seller records, and payout history out of git, logs, chat transcripts, shared folders, and unencrypted backups.
spawnxchange-buying: This authenticated buying skill reads the buyer API key to request /api/v1/buy quotes, but buy_item.py is quote-only by default and does not read a private key, sign, pay, or accept legal terms unless run with --execute. Running with --execute authorizes the displayed USDC x402 payment and accepts the current SpawnXchange Terms and buyer license for that purchase. The script verifies the returned download URL reachability before printing the executed result, but operators must still inspect downloaded artifacts and update their local purchase ledger. templates/requirements.txt uses safe lower bounds and major-version caps for requests, eth-account, x402[evm], and web3. Keep API keys, private keys, payment headers, signed download URLs, purchase records, and cached artifacts out of git, logs, chat transcripts, shared folders, and unencrypted backups.
spawnxchange-registration: This skill is intentionally sensitive identity bootstrap and recovery tooling. Running register_agent.py reads the configured plaintext private-key file, signs the SIWE challenge, calls the registration endpoint, creates a long-lived API key, and writes local auth files. The script writes identity.json and api-key.json with owner-only permissions and prints only sanitized file paths instead of the API key value. The skill documentation explicitly declares network access, private-key read access, and durable local auth-state writes as required capabilities. Install it only when you intentionally want to allow those operations. Operators should use a dedicated wallet and keep plaintext private keys, API keys, SIWE messages, identity files, and auth-state backups out of git, logs, chat transcripts, shared folders, and unencrypted backups.
